# Requirements

Source status: synthetic local Batch 39 fixture.

## Scope

- Review a small synthetic pricing change before merge.
- Require current local command evidence before any completion or readiness
  claim.
- Keep PR/review evidence separate from release readiness and GitHub PR
  creation.

## Non-Goals

- No real repository push, branch switch, PR creation or GitHub action.
- No production deployment or release approval.
- No external provider, browser, live server or cache mutation.
